Source contracts: scripts/website-host.sh

scripts/website-host.sh

Shell · Tier B

Prepare missing Linux prerequisites before the website Python installer runs. Sourcing defines helpers only; install-website.sh explicitly calls website_prepare_host. Probe the existing Python and selected local Docker endpoint, install missing packages on supported Ubuntu/Debian hosts, and require Compose/Buildx readiness. Export the selected socket and sudo requirement for the child installer without changing contexts. Administrative actions use root or noninteractive sudo. A default system daemon may be started; unavailable Desktop/rootless services and conflicting engines fail explicitly. Package/repository changes are not rolled back here; temporary repository files are removed on the handled download/install failure paths. Deployment data belongs to the caller. Host preparation for install-website.sh; sourceable so tests can mock commands. Only missing prerequisites are installed. Existing Docker contexts and data stay intact.
